job.title: Interim Contract Management Lead
job.description:
Interim Contract Management Lead
London
Day Rate (outside IR35)

Our Client is running a large supply chain transformation programme and are now looking for an experienced Interim Contract Management Lead to design and embed practical, post-award contract and supplier management across Corporate Services, covering a supplier portfolio in excess of £100M.

This is a hands-on transformation role to build a fit for purpose Contract Management function through improved supplier governance, supplier segmentation, performance management and contract lifecycle management.

What you'll do
  • Review the current supplier landscape and contract management maturity, mapping ownership, governance and capability gaps.
  • Design end-to-end contract management processes and define boundaries between Procurement, Supply Chain and Contract Management.
  • Build supplier categorisation and tiering frameworks based on spend, risk, criticality and strategic importance, with proportionate governance for each tier.
  • Create practical tools including scorecards, KPI dashboards, risk registers, service review templates and a contract management playbook.
  • Set up a benefits tracking approach and identify opportunities for supplier rationalisation, spend consolidation and value improvement.
  • Produce presentations, workshops and communications for audiences from Executive Leadership to operational teams, articulating the case for change.
  • Pilot governance reviews with strategic suppliers and support a smooth transition into permanent ownership.
What you'll bring
  • Strong contract and supplier management expertise, ideally across Corporate Services or indirect categories.
  • A track record of designing operating models, governance frameworks and supplier segmentation in a transformation setting.
  • Confident stakeholder engagement and influencing skills at Executive level, with the ability to drive change without direct line management.
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to produce clear, business-focused materials.
  • Must have previously built a Contract Management Framework before – not just managed Supplier Performance.
  • Experience in a public sector environment would be an advantage.
  • Must have UK right to work.

job.title: IT Professional Services Category Manager (3-6 months Contract)
job.description:
IT Professional Services Category Manager – 3-6 month Contract Role
USA – Remote Based
ProcureOne are working with a growing technology group to support them to recruit a contractor for a 3-6 month project to build their IT Professional Services Category Strategy.
Deliverables will include:
  • Assess the current landscape for the IT Professional Services Category through various mechanisms including analyzing historical spend, segmentation and contractual mapping.
  • Identify supplier fragmentation and supplier overlap
  • Drive stakeholder discovery meetings in order to manage and document pipeline, critical skill needs, supplier performance and operational constraints.
  • Build IT Professional Services Category Strategy, develop supplier rationalization model, benchmark rates, analyze market data, design the preferred supplier panel structure and rules of engagement, and quantify addressable spend and savings by value lever.
  • Execute sourcing and negotiation by running end to end tender process. Build rate card templates and pricing structures. Document awarded outcomes and negotiated savings.
  • Establish a supplier governance framework.
Suitable candidates will have proven IT Professional Services Category Management experience (eg Security, Consulting, Contingent Labor, Workforce Solutions).
You will have proven IT professional services category build experience – not purely maintenance of an inherited category.
Candidates must be able to demonstrate solid market knowledge of Professional services rate structures, markups, MSP/VMS commercial models.
You will have excellent data manipulation and stakeholder management experience – being able to build trust very quickly.
This project role is remote and can be based anywhere in the US. Must have US right to work.
